scripts.lint: oxlint packages --ignore-pattern "packages/*/tsdown.config.mts" --deny-warnings && oxlint packages --ignore-pattern "packages/*/tsdown.config.mts" --type-aware -A all -D typescript/no-floating-promises --ignore-pattern "**/*.test.*" --ignore-pattern "**/*.spec.*" --deny-warnings && oxfmt --check "packages/**/src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}"
scripts.lint:react-legacy: oxlint packages/DocumentElement packages/Modal packages/Popover packages/Portal packages/useAsync --ignore-pattern "packages/*/tsdown.config.mts" --deny-warnings && oxlint packages/DocumentElement packages/Modal packages/Popover packages/Portal packages/useAsync --ignore-pattern "packages/*/tsdown.config.mts" --type-aware -A all -D typescript/no-floating-promises --ignore-pattern "**/*.test.*" --ignore-pattern "**/*.spec.*" --deny-warnings && oxfmt --check "packages/{DocumentElement,Modal,Popover,Portal,useAsync}/src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}"
scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm compile && vitest run
scripts.test:react-legacy: pnpm lint:react-legacy && pnpm compile:react-legacy && REACT_LEGACY_TEST=1 vitest run
